# The Comprehensive List of RAG and Retrieval Tools

> a curated, source-linked directory of open-source and commercial software for retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector storage, reranking, ingestion, and RAG evaluation. Includes a machine-readable catalog. CC0 licensed. Reviewed monthly; last reviewed 2026-07-16.

Every entry links to a primary source. Availability markers distinguish open source, open weights, open core, commercial products, and public standards/resources. There is no paid placement. This independent directory is maintained by aglio-lab, and every entry follows the same evidence rules.

## Main content

- [Full list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/rag-retrieval-tools/main/README.md): 209 source-linked entries across 16 catalog sections
- [JSON catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/rag-retrieval-tools/main/data/tools.json): structured entity records
- [CSV catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/rag-retrieval-tools/main/data/tools.csv): flat machine-readable index
- [Monthly maintenance policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/rag-retrieval-tools/main/MAINTENANCE.md): review schedule and evidence rules

## Key categories

- RAG Frameworks and Orchestration (16 entries)
- Vector Databases and Vector Search Libraries (24 entries)
- Lexical and Hybrid Search Engines (11 entries)
- Managed Retrieval APIs and Knowledge Bases (15 entries)
- Embedding Models, APIs, and Libraries (16 entries)
- Rerankers and Late-Interaction Retrieval (12 entries)
- Document Parsing, OCR, and Chunking (15 entries)
- Web Crawling and Content Extraction (10 entries)
- Ingestion, ETL, and Connectors (8 entries)
- Graph RAG and Knowledge-Graph Retrieval (13 entries)
- Multimodal RAG and Retrieval (10 entries)
- Query Optimization and Retrieval Algorithms (11 entries)
- RAG Evaluation Frameworks and Platforms (16 entries)
- Retrieval and RAG Benchmarks (15 entries)
